buyer.answer: The master bedroom is 4.5 × 4.0 m (18 m²) on the 2nd floor, with a built-in wardrobe, a front-facing window and an en-suite bathroom.
The kitchen is 4.0 × 3.5 m (14 m²) on the 1st floor with fitted lower and upper cabinets, a tiled splashback and a side window. Stove and fridge are not included.

Included: fitted kitchen cabinets, sink and tap, water heater, bathroom fixtures, master wardrobe, ceramic floors, painted walls, windows, main door, 2,200 VA electricity, water connection, septic tank, carport roof, fence and gate. Not included: furniture, AC units, curtains, stove/fridge, landscaping.
10-year installment: down payment {dp_10} , monthly {monthly_10}, total {total_10}. Figures from the project pricing table (8 % demo rate).
Cash price is {cash_price_idr}, 5 % below the list price of {list_price_idr}. In this demo "Reserve" records your interest; no payment is taken.

Open Schedule, press Pay on the next unpaid period, choose VA (BCA, BNI, Mandiri) or QRIS. In this demo a simulator page plays the bank — never transfer real money.

DAO-financed means investors holding shares in the Residentstart DAO on NEAR fund your installment plan instead of a bank. You pay in rupiah; each repayment is recorded on-chain so they can verify it.
{if_unverified:Please complete identity verification on your dashboard first.}{if_verified:Choose Cash or Installment on your dashboard, pick a tenor, and confirm.}
